title.zh-TW: 勾選框打勾的描邊動畫

summary.zh-TW: 待辦清單的勾選框：勾選時方塊填色彈一下、勾勾一筆畫出來、文字劃上刪除線；取消時快速收回。真正的 checkbox 還在，鍵盤和讀屏軟體都能用。
summary.en: A to-do checkbox: checking pops the fill, draws the tick in one stroke and strikes through the text; unchecking retracts quickly. The real checkbox is still there for keyboards and screen readers.

text.zh-TW: 勾勾是 Phosphor 的 check 圖示，改成線條（stroke）版本才能用 DrawSVG 一筆畫出來。
text.en: The tick is Phosphor’s check icon converted to a stroke so DrawSVG can draw it in one line.

text.zh-TW: GSAP 動不到 ::after 這種偽元素，所以刪除線的長度寫成 CSS 變數，動畫改變數就好。
text.en: GSAP can’t reach pseudo-elements like ::after, so the strike length is a CSS variable and the animation changes the variable.

text.zh-TW: 真正的 checkbox 只是看不到，不是拿掉。點文字、按空白鍵、讀屏軟體都照常運作，畫面上的方塊只負責好看。
text.en: The real checkbox is only visually hidden, not removed. Clicking the label, pressing Space and screen readers all still work; the drawn box is just the look.

text.zh-TW: 填色放大時稍微超過再回來，像按下去的回饋。取消時用 power2.in 快速收回，不需要儀式感。
text.en: The fill overshoots slightly like a press; unchecking retracts quickly with power2.in — no ceremony needed.
